orders.name: Practice classroom
orders.phaseHelp: Use the supplies you have. Save your decisions, then mark yourself ready.
tasks: Check Treasury and food needs.
Allocate department funding and consider trades.
Build or repair settlements if affordable.
Save your plan and mark ready.

objectives.name: Happy homeland
objectives.description: Feed every civilian and regiment, keep at least 80% of your land at 80 happiness, and maintain your territory target for 5 consecutive rounds.
objectives.help: Economy plans food; Military can claim empty homeland; R&D can improve food production.
objectives.detail: 0/1 territories at 80 happiness; 1/2 territory target. 0/5 healthy rounds.

objectives.name: Growing economy
objectives.description: Invest 200 Treasury money in settlement or fortification upgrades, then produce 60% more than your starting full-happiness output for 3 consecutive rounds.
objectives.help: Develop productive land and fund discoveries. Trade and stockpiled resources are not production.
objectives.detail: 0/200 Treasury money invested; output value 107/258. 0/3 qualifying rounds.

objectives.name: Trade network
objectives.description: Build a lasting two-way trade balance worth 120 in each direction, across 2 partners and at least 5 trading rounds.
objectives.help: Trade value: money/food 1, wood 2, metal 3. Each partner needs net exports and imports worth at least 20. Gifts and reversed exchanges do not count.
objectives.detail: Net exports 0/120; imports 0/120; partners 0/2; trading rounds 0/5.

objectives.name: Secure frontier
objectives.description: Keep 3 territories beyond your starting holdings at 60 happiness, without hostile troops, for 3 consecutive fully supplied rounds.
objectives.help: Empty land counts: you do not need to attack another country. Losing land or neglecting food resets the streak.
objectives.detail: 0/3 new territories at 60 happiness. 0/3 supplied rounds.

objectives.name: Modern defense
objectives.description: Maintain 3 ready regiments of at least 2 types, each with improved equipment and at least 60 health, for 3 fully supplied rounds.
objectives.help: Ask R&D for equipment discoveries and Economy for metal, wood and military food.
objectives.detail: 0/3 improved regiments; 0/2 unit types. 0/3 supplied rounds.

objectives.name: Protected settlements
objectives.description: Keep 2 fortified settlements with at least 3 fortification levels between them, full defense health, and a ready 60-health garrison each, for 3 fully supplied rounds.
objectives.help: R&D unlocks walls; Economy funds them; Military provides a healthy garrison.
objectives.detail: 0/2 intact fortified settlements with garrisons; 0/3 fortification levels. 0/3 supplied rounds.

objectives.name: Independent discoveries
objectives.description: Complete 6 new discoveries through your own funded research across at least 3 branches. Joint research counts.
objectives.help: Imported, captured and freely received discoveries are useful but do not count as your research achievement.
objectives.detail: 0/6 funded discoveries; 0/3 branches.

objectives.name: Knowledge exchange
objectives.description: Share or jointly research 4 different discoveries you helped complete, working with at least 2 other countries.
objectives.help: You retain every discovery. Both partners must fund joint work. Repeating one technology or forwarding someone else’s work gives no extra credit.
objectives.detail: 0/4 shared or joint discoveries; 0/2 recipients.

objectives.name: Useful innovation
objectives.description: Complete 6 useful city actions across at least 4 rounds, using at least 2 different facility types.
objectives.help: Hospitals must restore health; civic halls must help a territory below 80 happiness; granaries must fill a food shortage or reserve below two civilian meals. Workshops and useful academy progress count. Each facility type earns at most one action credit per round.
objectives.detail: 0/6 useful actions; 0/2 ability types; 0/4 action rounds.

objectives.detail: 0/6 useful actions; 0/2 ability types; 0/4 action rounds.

objectives.name: Happy homeland
objectives.description: Feed every civilian and regiment, keep at least 80% of your land at 80 happiness, and maintain your territory target for 5 consecutive rounds.
objectives.help: Economy plans food; Military can claim empty homeland; R&D can improve food production.
objectives.detail: 0/1 territories at 80 happiness; 1/2 territory target. 0/5 healthy rounds.

objectives.name: Growing economy
objectives.description: Invest 200 Treasury money in settlement or fortification upgrades, then produce 60% more than your starting full-happiness output for 3 consecutive rounds.
objectives.help: Develop productive land and fund discoveries. Trade and stockpiled resources are not production.
objectives.detail: 0/200 Treasury money invested; output value 117/258. 0/3 qualifying rounds.

objectives.name: Trade network
objectives.description: Build a lasting two-way trade balance worth 120 in each direction, across 2 partners and at least 5 trading rounds.
objectives.help: Trade value: money/food 1, wood 2, metal 3. Each partner needs net exports and imports worth at least 20. Gifts and reversed exchanges do not count.
objectives.detail: Net exports 0/120; imports 0/120; partners 0/2; trading rounds 0/5.

objectives.name: Secure frontier
objectives.description: Keep 3 territories beyond your starting holdings at 60 happiness, without hostile troops, for 3 consecutive fully supplied rounds.
objectives.help: Empty land counts: you do not need to attack another country. Losing land or neglecting food resets the streak.
objectives.detail: 0/3 new territories at 60 happiness. 0/3 supplied rounds.

objectives.name: Modern defense
objectives.description: Maintain 3 ready regiments of at least 2 types, each with improved equipment and at least 60 health, for 3 fully supplied rounds.
objectives.help: Ask R&D for equipment discoveries and Economy for metal, wood and military food.
objectives.detail: 0/3 improved regiments; 0/2 unit types. 0/3 supplied rounds.

objectives.name: Protected settlements
objectives.description: Keep 2 fortified settlements with at least 3 fortification levels between them, full defense health, and a ready 60-health garrison each, for 3 fully supplied rounds.
objectives.help: R&D unlocks walls; Economy funds them; Military provides a healthy garrison.
objectives.detail: 0/2 intact fortified settlements with garrisons; 0/3 fortification levels. 0/3 supplied rounds.

objectives.name: Independent discoveries
objectives.description: Complete 6 new discoveries through your own funded research across at least 3 branches. Joint research counts.
objectives.help: Imported, captured and freely received discoveries are useful but do not count as your research achievement.
objectives.detail: 0/6 funded discoveries; 0/3 branches.

objectives.name: Knowledge exchange
objectives.description: Share or jointly research 4 different discoveries you helped complete, working with at least 2 other countries.
objectives.help: You retain every discovery. Both partners must fund joint work. Repeating one technology or forwarding someone else’s work gives no extra credit.
objectives.detail: 0/4 shared or joint discoveries; 0/2 recipients.
